result.title: MuSID-KD: Multigranularity Knowledge Distillation for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
result.summary: Generative recommendation with semantic IDs (SIDs) represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens and autoregressively predicts the next item's SID. Despite strong recommendation performance, repeated decoding over multiple SID positions incurs substantial inference cost. Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a powerful generative teacher to a lightweight student, yet conventional objectives do not fully account for multi-token SID generation. We identify two limitations: item-level distribution alignment may not adequately preserve the teacher's ranking of candidate groups sharing SID prefixes, while uniform alignment across SID positions may affect final item ranking differently. We propose MuSID-KD, which combines Hierarchical Candidate Distribution Alignment (HCDA) and Ranking Impact Guided Levelwise Distillation (RIGD). HCDA aggregates item probabilities according to shared SID prefixes and aligns candidate distributions at successive levels, from candidate groups to individual items. RIGD evaluates the reduction in pairwise ranking surrogate loss when one student score contribution is replaced with the teacher's contribution, and allocates supervision accordingly. Experiments on real-world recommendation datasets using three lightweight student architectures demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy and better alignment of prefix marginal distributions and pairwise item rankings, without modifying the student's online inference architecture. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/m7k2-review-83f9/.

AI.brief_summary: 面向以 semantic IDs 表示的生成式推荐，提出 MuSID-KD 蒸馏框架：按共享 SID 前缀聚合候选概率做多层级分布对齐（HCDA），并按各 SID 位置对最终 pairwise 排序损失的贡献分配监督（RIGD），在不改动学生在线推理结构的前提下提升推荐准确率与排序一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按生成位置量化对最终排序目标的贡献并据此分配监督的思路，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的逐步监督与贡献分配提供线索，可供核查该贡献度量能否迁移到中间推理状态。
